title: Employment Pass to Attract and Retain Foreign Nurses at Restructured Hospitals
what_it_is: Employment Pass to Attract and Retain Foreign Nurses at Restructured Hospitals

sections.label: Foreign nurses work pass flexibility
sections.summary: MOH works with MOM on work pass flexibility and recruitment of local and foreign healthcare staff to augment the workforce and keep salaries competitive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The healthcare sector, currently, brings in foreign nurses using the Employment Pass or S Pass.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH has already been working with MOM to exercise appropriate flexibility under the work pass framework to meet the sector's manpower needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We also work closely with our public healthcare institutions to shore up recruitment for both local and foreign staff to augment the healthcare workforce, as well as to ensure that salaries remain competitive.

sections.label: MOH MOM flexibility arrangements
sections.summary: MOH is working closely with MOM on appropriate flexibility arrangements to manage numbers, and takes the matter seriously.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, MOH is working very closely with MOM on this and we will look at how we can work on the appropriate flexibility arrangements so that we can manage the numbers that we are looking at.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: All these issues are, indeed, the matters that we are currently working on and I hope that the Member can share with the nurses who have given him this feedback that this is something that we take seriously and that we will be working on these matters.
